text: Upon this a question arises: whether it be better to be loved than feared or feared than loved? It may be answered that one should wish to be both, but, because it is difficult to unite them in one person, it is much safer to be feared than loved, when, of the two, either must be dispensed with.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XVII, Concerning cruelty and clemency, and whether it is better to be loved than feared
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
